classifiedBy: engine author, for the user's review; categories per the user's A/B/C/D scheme of 2026-09-25

categories.A: existing ontology can express it - needs a semantic decision or better evidence, engine unchanged
categories.B: evidence extraction gap - a general feature for every document, Layer A/B may change
categories.C: real ontology gap - a new cross-document semantic concept
categories.D: document-specific exception - never enters the engine

replayHistory.state: first blind replay, recorded as is
after three category-B fixes, each general
fixes: B1 contents entries point forward: only an earlier, weaker copy of a text that reappears later outside a table (or a line ending in a page number, or a built-in TOC style) is a contents entry; the first version treated the target heading as an entry too (30 of the 53 false-proposed misses, and false 'contents runs' built from column headers repeated across tables)
B2 two general lexical shapes: a whole occurrence in brackets or a long parenthesis is an editorial note; a caption may be numbered by a letter or follow 'Table:'
B3 a sentence-length table cell is prose, not a table row (tables used for layout); a strongly set label in a table that opens at least as much prose as rows is NEEDS_REVIEW, not FALSE

remainingDiscrepancies.what: note-local labels set only weakly (10pt italic) are NEEDS_REVIEW; the user decided them true
remainingDiscrepancies.note: by design: standalone + opens a region is a semantic call, not a typography gate

remainingDiscrepancies.what: revision dates over their notes, the MD&A part title on its contents page, the cover title block: NEEDS_REVIEW, decided true
cover: the engine cannot separate the issuer line from the title lines (same setting); the decomposition is semantic

composite boundaries: two consecutive centered form titles merged into one ('Appendix to Proposal' + 'Schedule of Cost Indexation'), form subtitles ('Demand Guarantee') not merged into their form title, title blocks cut where a line changes setting
strongly set lines that are not headings by meaning: 'PART n' list rows inside a table, 'Or'/'OR' connectives, 'Sample ... Table' unnumbered captions, 'FIDIC code' metadata, form codes ('Form PER-1')
chart title inside a figure ('Top Ten Country Exposures'); 'This page left intentionally blank'
misses not set apart at all or set weakly in a table: '1. Purpose', 'SEA and/or SH Declaration', DAAB clause labels in a layout table (now NEEDS_REVIEW)
contents openers whose own text repeats elsewhere ('Table of Content', 'Table of Forms') are still read as entries
remainingDiscrepancies.candidateFix: an occurrence directly before a contents run whose text is not a trailing-page-number line is the opener even if its text repeats
